descriptions.normal: Dried fish that has been grilled slowly over a charcoal flame. Fish air-dried overnight have a tinge of the salty sea wind and give off a tantalizing flavor when grilled. Many Inazumans who dwell near the sea know this taste well indeed.
descriptions.suspicious: Dried fish that has been grilled slowly over a charcoal flame. Every last droplet of moisture within the fish has been drained away, leaving behind naught but a texture that can only be compared to chewing on timber. One can barely tell the difference between fish and bones in here.
descriptions.delicious: Dried fish that has been grilled slowly over a charcoal flame. The rich fats ooze out as the fish meets the grill, and with those sizzling sounds, the fish is clothed in a burnished golden coat. The meat is firm but delicious, and the mouthfeel is quite delicate. Such is the unsurpassed gift of the seas.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
